label: development (walk-forward), used to choose the model; not the result
selection_rule: amendment 4, item 6: lowest pooled validation fair CRPS averaged over 6/12/24 h among the G+R candidates; within 1 %, the lower Brier for >= 148 ft within 24 h

inputs.what: Stage 4 development inputs, read from frozen sources before any fit

excluded_overflow_records.why: first SR 544 record (gauge record start), not an onset the gauge could see begin

onset_within_6h.note: uses the 6-h level quantiles (no 6-h window target in amendment 4)

onset_timing.note: needs d_1, d_3, d_6 and d_12

T_table.what: prepare (P(>=148 ft within 24 h)) alert: hours before the >=148 ft crossing per event; FAR <= 0.5
T_table.timing_part: not assessable: no agency recorded when water reached the border or the farm's zone; protocol §6 claims no accuracy without >= 3 verifiable arrival times. Hours before the overflow onset are shown
T_table.note: City-alert comparisons exist for held-out 2021/2025 only (amendment 1, A8)

T_table.what: move (overflow within 12 h) alert: POD >= 0.8 and FAR <= 0.2
T_table.timing_part: not assessable: no agency recorded when water reached the border or the farm's zone; protocol §6 claims no accuracy without >= 3 verifiable arrival times. Hours before the overflow onset are shown

T_table.what: moderate_148ft_within_12h: BSS vs persistence >= 0.10; ECE <= 0.05 per horizon
